records.deidentified_narrative: pedestrian's (ped) mother called from home to report [school facility]. contacted ped and parents at their residence. ped and father showed this officer where the crash occurred. ped states the crash occurred at [roadway] [school facility] on the 6100 blk of fountainwood where it makes a 90 degree turn. ped states he was on his skateboard, at the corner and on the sidewalk. ped states unknown sedan (either silver, gold, or gray) drove [roadway] completely across to [roadway], jumped the curb and struck ped. ped states he was struck on his back right hip causing him to lose balance and fall off his skateboard, injuring his [school facility] district bus #90 was present and that the bus driver saw what happened. ped states when he fell off his skateboard [roadway]. ped states the driver of unit #1, [school facility] bus driver, and anyone else around did not check on him. ped states unit #1 drove away [roadway]. ped states the bus driver then drove over ped's skateboard (with front and back tires) as the bus also left the location travelling on fountainwood the same direction as unit #1. ped states that he has one friend who witnessed what happened. ped gave a vague description of unit #1 but later said unit #1 had spoked, chrome rims with approximately 20 spokes pers rim. ped also said that unit #1 was lowered like a lowrider car and had lightly tinted windows. the curbline at the crash site had no visible scuff/tire marks. there was nothing obvious indicating that a crash had occurred. ped's skateboard was unbroken and still functional despite having been driven over by the bus. ped had no visible injury but complaint of soreness to back right hip and pain to his left wrist from the fall. ems refused. ped's father given the [case id] and number to traffic investigations for follow-up. t. i. d. detective bacarreza #2026 notified of the crash report by phone at 1744 hrs.

records.public_safe_text: pedestrian's (ped) mother called from home to report [school facility]. contacted ped and parents at their residence. ped and father showed this officer where the crash occurred. ped states the crash occurred at [roadway] [school facility] on the 6100 blk of fountainwood where it makes a 90 degree turn. ped states he was on his skateboard, at the corner and on the sidewalk. ped states unknown sedan (either silver, gold, or gray) drove [roadway] completely across to [roadway], jumped the curb and struck ped. ped states he was struck on his back right hip causing him to lose balance and fall off his skateboard, injuring his [school facility] district bus #90 was present and that the bus driver saw what happened. ped states when he fell off his skateboard [roadway]. ped states the driver of unit #1, [school facility] bus driver, and anyone else around did not check on him. ped states unit #1 drove away [roadway]. ped states the bus driver then drove over ped's skateboard (with front and back tires) as the bus also left the location travelling on fountainwood the same direction as unit #1. ped states that he has one friend who witnessed what happened. ped gave a vague description of unit #1 but later said unit #1 had spoked, chrome rims with approximately 20 spokes pers rim. ped also said that unit #1 was lowered like a lowrider car and had lightly tinted windows. the curbline at the crash site had no visible scuff/tire marks. there was nothing obvious indicating that a crash had occurred. ped's skateboard was unbroken and still functional despite having been driven over by the bus. ped had no visible injury but complaint of soreness to back right hip and pain to his left wrist from the fall. ems refused. ped's father given the [case id] and number to traffic investigations for follow-up. t. i. d. detective bacarreza #2026 notified of the crash report by phone at 1744 hrs.

records.public_safe_text: williamson county sheriff's office deputy sergeant francesco saenz was conducting traffic control at approximately the 6124 blk of w sh 29 on a separate crash in the immediate area. sgt. saenz was actively redirecting westbound traffic to turn around and away from the separate crash scene area while assisting agency (dps) personnel conducted their investigation. sgt. saenz was struck by unit#1 in the roadway. sgt. saenz stated he was directing vehicles with his hands actively turning around at this time including unit#1. sgt. sanez stated unit#1 attempted to get around the other vehicles turning around and appeared to be making a wider turn around. sgt. sanez stated he had already directed unit#1 with hands motioning him to turn around and believed unit 1 was doing so. sgt. sanez stated he turned his back to the vehicles turning around and proceeded to give them turning space. at this time sgt. sanez stated he felt abrupt pressure from behind at his knees that began to actively push him forward off his balance. sgt. saenz stated he immediately attempted to turn his head around and observed unit 1 directly behind him. sgt. saenz stated he began yelling and slapping the hood of unit 1 to get the drivers attention. sgt. saenz stated unit 1 came to a stop momentarily. sgt. saenz stated due to the nature of the contact he rested his backside on the front of the hood of unit 1. at this time sgt. sanez stated unit 1 again began to slowly move forward. sgt. saenz again stated he had to yell at the driver of unit 1 to stop moving forward. immediately after the contact sgt. saenz radioed for aid from nearby deputies on scene. sgt. saenz was assisted by deputies and ems personnel on scene. sgt. sanez was wearing a traffic control vest at the time of contact. sgt. sanez was directing traffic near his patrol unit with its emergency lights active at the time of contact.
